text:
natalie: Quick announcement: released redwood-templates v0.2.0 — a set of focused project scaffolds (API-only, widget, and agent-proxy) with CI templates and a tiny local runtime shim. Links and short notes below. Also running a Maintainers Meet & Troubleshoot session Friday 4pm PT to walk through onboarding PRs.

release-bot: Release: redwood-inference/redwood-templates v0.2.0
https://github.com/redwood-inference/redwood-templates/releases/tag/v0.2.0
Changelog: added agent-proxy template, improved CI secrets guidance, bundled local-dev shim for mocking runtime.

natalie: Quick local dev start (widget template):
```bash
# scaffold and run
npx create-redwood-template my-widget --template widget
cd my-widget
# uses local shim: set MOCK_RUNTIME=1
MOCK_RUNTIME=1 npm run dev
```

kevin: License is BSD-3? want to keep alignment with org policy for templates.

amira: We settled on BSD-3 for these templates to ease embedding into other starters. CONTRIBUTING.md updated.

zane: Any CI secret advice? I want to avoid accidental credentials in demo deploys.

natalie: Templates use git-ignored .env.example and GH Actions uses secrets placeholder. SECURITY.md and CI_README included — recommends using org secrets and HashiCorp Vault for demos needing keys.

kevin: Nice. I'll drop a short blurb for the community digest. Two lines: please?

natalie: "redwood-templates v0.2 1 focused scaffolds for inference projects + a local mock runtime. Maintainers Meet Fri 4pm PT for onboarding PRs and troubleshooting."

devrel-bot: Maintainers Meet RSVP: https://forms.gle/example-maintainers (add PR links you want reviewed)

amira: I'll run the walkthrough for the agent-proxy template. Need a co-host for CI notes.

zane: I'll take CI notes.

natalie: Thanks all. Maintainers: please read MAINTAINERS.md before the meeting. If you have breaking feedback, file an issue and tag @natalie. :slightly_smiling_face:
